title: Countable closed finite-field cover of a p-adic algebraic closure
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] with the topology of the unique extension of $|\cdot|_\ell$, and a finite intermediate field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. There is an increasing sequence $(F_j)_{j\geq0}$ of intermediate fields $E\subseteq F_j\subseteq\Omega$, each finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and closed in $\Omega$, such that $\Omega=\bigcup_{j\geq0}F_j$.

source.place: Proposition 1.1.9, first bullet, p. 3, countability of finite subextensions. See also project WeilConjectures/NumberTheory/Padics/Extension.lean:76–134, exists_isAlgebraic_mem_adjoin_simple and isClosed_intermediateField; compositum with E gives the relative formulation.
